name: tokopt-vscode
description: Token-cost CodeLens + anti-pattern Diagnostics + Quick Fix + Status bar (always-on tax) + Token Cost TreeView for Copilot customization files (instructions, agents, skills).

tokopt.codeLens.enabled.description: Show inline token-cost CodeLens on Copilot customization files.

tokopt.diagnostics.enabled.description: Surface tokopt detect anti-pattern findings in the Problems panel. Refreshes on save of any customization file.

tokopt.binaryPath.description: Path to the tokopt binary. Use 'tokopt' to resolve from PATH, or an absolute path.

tokopt.creditModel.markdownDescription:
Project token counts into **AI Credits (AIU)** and **USD** using this model's rate card (`tokopt --credit-model`). Use `none` to show token counts only.

The model picker is populated from your installed tokopt binary (`tokopt models`), so it lists every model the embedded rate card can price — 4 empirically measured plus catalog-derived rates for the rest. To cost-project a model the binary doesn't know, point `#tokopt.creditRatesPath#` at an external `rate-card.json` and set this to a model it defines. An unknown model degrades to tokens-only. `1 AIU = $0.01`.

tokopt.creditRatesPath.markdownDescription: Path to an external tokopt `rate-card.json` (passed as `tokopt --credit-rates`). Lets you cost-project **any model** — add `{"models": {"<model>": {"rate_status": "ok", "nano_aiu_per_input_token": <rate>}}}` entries. When set, its models replace the embedded card in the picker. Leave empty to use the built-in rate card.

tokopt.requestsPerDay.markdownDescription: Assumed Copilot requests per day, used to project the **monthly** cost of the always-on tax in the CodeLens, status bar, and Optimization Report. Only affects display when `#tokopt.creditModel#` is set.

tokopt.usage.maxSessions.markdownDescription: Maximum number of Copilot CLI session logs (newest first) to scan for the **Usage Analysis** view. Lower this if scanning `~/.copilot/session-state/` is slow.

tokopt.statusBar.enabled.description: Show the always-on tax in the status bar. Sums tokens across well-known always-on customization files at the workspace root and .github/.

tokopt.statusBar.warnThreshold.description: Background turns warning-coloured when the always-on tax reaches this many tokens.

tokopt.statusBar.errorThreshold.description: Background turns error-coloured when the always-on tax reaches this many tokens.

tokopt.treeView.enabled.description: Show the Token Cost TreeView in the Explorer sidebar. Lists customization files grouped by scope (always-on / conditional / on-demand) and sorted by token count. Refreshes lazily — first audit runs only after you open the view.

tokopt.treeView.warnThreshold.description: Files (and category totals) reaching this many tokens show a warning icon (yellow) in the Token Cost TreeView.

tokopt.treeView.errorThreshold.description: Files (and category totals) reaching this many tokens show an error icon (red) in the Token Cost TreeView. Clamped to be >= treeView.warnThreshold at runtime.
